history.history_preservation_rule: C3-R1 and C3-R2 artifacts and results remain unchanged; their dense outcomes are excluded from the C3-R3 aggregate denominator.
history.c3_r3_resume: Resumed after the earlier attempt was environment-blocked before Stage A; the authoritative index then passed read-only preflight and the locked R3 screening and dense-only Stage B were executed.

r2_residual_screening_state.residual_activation_report: descriptive only: qualified cases among the complete 31-case residual screening population; not a C3 pass gate

preregistration.hypothesis: Conditional on the frozen C3 SemanticQueryBuilder changing dense query text, semantic augmentation is safe for dense retrieval.
preregistration.screening_rule: Call the production C2 analyzer exactly once for every remaining ID in the exact locked order, construct the production RetrievalPlan, build_semantic_query(question, plan), and classify treatment-qualified iff SemanticQuery.text != raw question.
preregistration.complete_screening_rule: All 11 remaining IDs must be screened; do not stop early and do not extend the candidate set.
preregistration.selection_rule: After screening, use all five carried-forward qualified cases plus every newly treatment-qualified remaining case; do not subsample or select on outcomes.
preregistration.stage_b_cohort_rule: The final fresh Stage-B cohort is frozen before the first embedding call and contains all eligible carried-forward and newly qualified cases.
preregistration.critical_evidence_applicability: Use existing required-evidence-group semantics; report N/A when no applicable critical labels exist, never encode unmeasured coverage as zero.
preregistration.critical_evidence_guard: new critical evidence misses == 0 where critical evidence is applicable
preregistration.informativeness_guard: informative_case_count >= ceil(Stage-B cohort size / 2), where informative_case means PRE or POST has a relevant hit within top 20
preregistration.contamination_guard: Every POST augmentation must exclude reviewed expansion paths/files/methods, rejected analyzer items, page hints, object/evidence/Gold IDs, and hidden repository/version metadata; raw question is exempt.
preregistration.mrr_rule: Measure and report MRR as a diagnostic; no independent POST MRR hard gate.
preregistration.historical_r1_exclusion: C3-R1 outcomes, including g110 and g050 diagnostics, are not included in C3-R3 aggregate metrics or gates.

metric_definitions.required_evidence_semantics: Existing authoritative required-evidence-group matching semantics from panda_agent.evaluation; no parallel evaluator definition.
metric_definitions.recall_at_k: Mean per-case fraction of required evidence groups matched by the top-k dense object IDs, for k in 5, 10, 20.
metric_definitions.mrr: Mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant required-evidence-group hit; zero when no relevant hit occurs in top 20.
metric_definitions.first_relevant_rank: One-based rank of the first top-20 object satisfying an authoritative required-evidence-group match; null when no hit.
metric_definitions.critical_coverage: Mean fraction of critical required-evidence groups matched within top 20; N/A if no applicable critical labels.
metric_definitions.informative_case: PRE or POST has at least one relevant hit within top 20.

rank_classification.improved: POST relevant rank < PRE relevant rank
rank_classification.recovered_hit: PRE has no relevant hit and POST has a relevant hit
rank_classification.no_hit_both: no relevant hit in either condition
rank_classification.regressed: POST relevant rank > PRE relevant rank
rank_classification.lost_hit: PRE has a relevant hit and POST has none

closeout.decision_reason: C3-R3 resumed after the earlier attempt was environment-blocked before Stage A. The authoritative panda_knowledge_v1 index was reachable and identity-compatible (green, populated, dense 3072, schema 4), all 11 locked Stage-A cases were screened in order, and a six-case PRE/POST dense-only Stage B ran with 12 query embeddings and 12 dense reads. The observed gates were not met: POST Recall@20 0.250000 < PRE 0.333333, new critical misses=2, and negative_direction_count=2 > positive_direction_count=0. The closeout remains INCONCLUSIVE rather than a complete PASS/FAIL decision because the first nine valid Stage-A plan snapshots were lost after a runner serialization error and g018 could not be semantically reconstructed to its blinded historical snapshot; no duplicate analyzer calls were authorized.

g018 carried-forward semantic reconstruction differed from its blinded R2 snapshot; its frozen historical text was retained, but the case is an evidence-integrity limitation.
No new C3-R4 or Gold sampling round was started after this INCONCLUSIVE resume.
